plan: ADR-031 in OpenVibe.Contracts and its amendments of 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-14 (OpenVibe.Zone replaces the planned OpenVibe.Data); live since 2026-10-14
summary: OpenVibe.Zone — private S3-compatible storage zones for OpenVibe projects (ADR-031 amendment). Zone owns the zone record and its control API; OpenVibe.Media owns the objects, bytes, keys, quotas and the S3 surface at s3.openvibe.media.
works: Default zone per project environment, created on first use
Named zones: create (Idempotency-Key), list, read with live usage, update description and quota, delete (recursive, refuses held objects)
Provisioning in Media by revision; provisioning → active once Media acknowledges; a 15 s job retries and finishes deletions
Console: projects, zones, usage, S3 access keys issued through Media (secret shown once)
Resource index and control (delete) for OpenVibe.Services
Per-zone usage by the hour: Media's media.usage.recorded rollups, kept and summed for the console
Over Media's S3 surface (2026-10-15): multipart uploads and server-side copies (CopyObject, UploadPartCopy)
